description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDisplayField' for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It specifies properties and methods related to display fields in reports, including ORM mappings and field attributes.

classes.name: AbstractDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract class representing display fields within report groups, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: getReportGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the associated ReportGroup object.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates a ReportGroup object with this display field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the display field.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the display field.

methods.name: getFieldAlias
methods.description: Returns the field alias, if any.

methods.name: setFieldAlias
methods.description: Sets the field alias.

methods.name: isSortable
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is sortable.

methods.name: setSortable
methods.description: Sets the sortable property.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Gets the sort order setting.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Gets the sort field.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the sort field.

methods.name: getElementType
methods.description: Returns the element type for this display field.

methods.name: setElementType
methods.description: Sets the element type.

methods.name: getElementProperty
methods.description: Returns the element property for this display field.

methods.name: setElementProperty
methods.description: Sets the element property.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width property of the display field.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the display field.

methods.name: isExportable
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is exportable.

methods.name: setExportable
methods.description: Sets the exportable property.

methods.name: getTextAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the text alignment style.

methods.name: setTextAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Sets the text alignment style.

methods.name: isValueList
methods.description: Checks if the field is a value list.

methods.name: setIsValueList
methods.description: Sets whether the field is a value list.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated DisplayFieldGroup.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Associates a DisplayFieldGroup.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default value.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value.

methods.name: isEncrypted
methods.description: Checks if the field is encrypted.

methods.name: setEncrypted
methods.description: Sets the encryption flag.

methods.name: isMeta
methods.description: Checks if the field is meta.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the meta property.
